string.text: Near a lit campfire, each tick first adds temporary health on a random limb still below 80%. Only when every limb is at 80% total does it convert temporary into permanent (up to 80%) or heal main health (up to 80%). Suppresses Campfire slowly regens life (arti); keep DOGMA below it in MO2, or disable that mod.
Seconds between each heal tick (1-30). Lower = faster.
